title: Apollo customer scratchpad - VPC & rollout checklist
body:
Morning scratchpad for Apollo engagement - notes + quick checklist

Context:
- Customer: Apollo Financial Services (prod-facing chatbot + embeddings for KYC search)
- Deployment target: Redwood Private (VPC on AWS account owned by customer) with optional on-prem stub for disaster recovery tests.
- Primary concerns: network isolation, KMS/HSM integration, audit logs, deterministic latency (<200ms p95), and model pinning for compliance.

Today goals (high level):
- Finalize VPC peering requirements and send exact CIDR ranges to customer networking (Claire to confirm).
- Validate KMS key usage pattern: customer requires key usage logs forwarded to their SIEM. Confirm HSM vs KMS options.
- Dry run of canary rollout using a 10% traffic split to dedicated private nodes.
- Add prompt test suite for Apollo-specific PII redaction checks.

Immediate action items (TODO):
- [ ] Send VPC CIDR template and required ports (Elena) - include TCP 443 for control plane, TCP 50051 for internal gRPC, UDP ephemeral for metrics agent
- [ ] Ask infra to surface egress IPs used when contacting customer KMS (Samir)
- [ ] Create KMS policy example for customer to attach to their key (Derrick)
- [ ] Upload initial prompt/eval set to shared S3 bucket and add to Redwood Optimize monitor (Claire)
- [ ] Prepare rollback playbook for canary (Elena) - steps + SLAs + contact list

Notes from 2026-02-27 call with Apollo network team:
- They will not allow inbound from public subnets. Need a Transit Gateway peering or PrivateLink.
- They prefer mutual TLS between control plane and their endpoint; certs managed by customer CA.
- Compliance team asked for envelope encryption: tokens must never land unencrypted on disk in their account. Need to confirm Redwood Private disk encryption behavior (are we using customer-managed keys for EBS?).

Architecture checklist (rough):
- Private control plane endpoint in customer VPC (NLB + mTLS) -> needs cert chain + SNI mapping
- Serving nodes in private subnets, autoscale group pinned to dedicated instance types (A10 -> qps target 250/s)
- Edge proxy in shared services VPC for telemetry aggregation (metrics forwarded to customer's Prometheus/Grafana via secure tunnel)
- KMS: prefer CMEK (customer-managed) for encryption at rest; HSM required? flagged by compliance as optional but desired

Quick config snippets (for internal reference):
- Example cert CN mapping: controlplane.apollo.redwood.local -> client cert subject matches /O=Apollo/OU=SecOps
- Minimal NACL rules: allow outbound 443 to Redwood control plane, block 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on serving subnets

Canary rollout plan (initial):
- Phase 0 (smoke): 5% traffic to canary nodes running model: redwood/tuned-13b-int8 (pin to v2026-02-15 build)
- Phase 1 (load): 10% traffic, run acceptance tests: latency, token cost delta, and Apollo eval suite
- Phase 2 (verify): 10k requests over 24h, check quality regression alerts in Redwood Optimize (threshold: >1% regression triggers halt)
- Phase 3 (ramp): 50% then 100% if no hits over 48h. Rollback immediate if p95 latency > 2x baseline or errors > 0.5%

Test prompts to add to eval set (quick bullets):
- PII redaction: example SSN, account numbers, emails embedded in longer query - verify model returns redacted placeholders, not raw values
- KYC lookup: given name + dob, verify embedding distance metric returns correct candidate within top-5 (embedding cosine > 0.82)
- Safety: adversarial instruction test (attempt to get model to produce sensitive internal policies)

Open questions / unresolved:
- Does our runtime support customer-managed key for swap of model weights on disk? (Asked in infra slack, waiting)
- If customer requires HSM-backed signing of tokens, do we have an API to route signing calls to their HSM proxy?
- Network egress — are there any third-party telemetry endpoints we hit during model loading that would require allowlisting?

Next sync (internal): 2026-03-03 10:00 PT with Claire + Samir to prepare docs for customer.
Customer sync scheduled: 2026-03-06 09:30 PT - prep: send VPC template + canary plan 24h prior.

In-line references / quick links:
- Internal infra ticket: JIRA SE-4127 (KMS + VPC checklist)
- Confluence draft: INFRA-Apollo-VPC-Design (will attach after meeting)

Personal notes (brain dump):
- Keep rollout conservative; Apollo's risk profile is low tolerance.
- Prepare a short one-page "what failsafe looks like" for execs (2 bullets: automatic fallback to hosted small model + contact pager)
- Remind to copy legal about data residency note before final sign-off

End of scratchpad for now.

Logged by: Elena Morales (solutions eng)
